hero.description: I’m David, a frontend developer based in Budapest. As the founder of Davelopment, I specialize in designing and developing custom websites to help businesses and individuals stand out in the digital space.

about.intro: I’m David Vasadi. I live in Budapest, where I design the future.
about.p1: I’ve been passionate about creating and innovating since childhood. However, it took time to discover what I truly wanted to do. I explored various fields, learned, and grew until I realized that web development is where I can truly thrive. Since finding this path, it has brought immense happiness to my life, and I am endlessly grateful for it.
about.p2: Over the years, I’ve mastered numerous technologies and delved deeply into building modern designs. To me, a great website is not only visually appealing but also user-friendly, fast, and efficient.
about.p3: I’ve worked on projects like a time tracking system and csontkovacsbence.hu, where I delivered comprehensive services by combining unique design with modern development solutions – from planning to SEO optimization and Google Analytics integration.
about.p4: My passion lies in full-stack development, maximizing user experience, and crafting solutions that truly create value.

work1.title: Hungaroton Artist List
work1.description: A modern web application that integrates APIs to display artist data, supporting search, pagination, and filtering while offering a responsive, user-friendly experience.
work1.description2: During this project, I encountered several technological challenges, including integrating Next.js, React, and Material-UI, as well as optimizing API calls using debouncing techniques to enhance the user experience.
work1.content: The goal of this project is to provide users with a clear and dynamic interface for accessing artist data, enabling fast and efficient search and filtering, while leveraging the benefits of modern web technologies.
work1.content2: The application utilizes a modern React and Next.js architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability, while optimizing the user experience through robust API integration and debouncing techniques.

work2.title: Time Tracking System
work2.description: Helps companies efficiently manage employees working hours, thereby increasing productivity and optimizing work time...
work2.description2: During the project, I encountered several new technological challenges, such as mastering Vue.js component structures and state management. I improved in dynamic data handling and the use of Vue Router, as well as enhancing the user experience to make the system intuitive and easy to use.
work2.content2: The application was mainly developed for companies to help them manage employees work hours more effectively, thus increasing productivity.

work3.title: Csontkovacsbence
work3.description: An online presentation platform with a unique design, providing a fast, responsive, and SEO-optimized experience for visitors, making services easily accessible and promotable.
work3.description2: Both the frontend and backend were developed using modern JavaScript, with animations and interactive elements to improve the user experience. The website includes a custom design that I developed, taking both visual appearance and functionality into account.
work3.content: The website is SEO-optimized with proper meta tags, keywords, and responsive design to ensure it is easily indexed by search engines. With Google Analytics integration, I tracked visitor behavior and conversions to fine-tune the site. Using cPanel, I managed the site's settings, including database configurations, SSL certificate installation, and automatic backups.
work3.content2: My goal was to create a fast, secure, and well-optimized website that adheres to modern development and SEO standards.

work4.title: Kókai Zoltán Grant Writing
work4.description: The website was built with a custom-designed layout and bespoke WordPress dynamic code, enabling content management and blogging while ensuring a personalized and professional appearance.
work4.description2: I created a personalized template for the site, which I published as a theme in WordPress. The website allows for the creation of blogs, making it easy to update and expand.
work4.content: I crafted every element of the design using custom coding, focusing on both the visual appearance and functionality. The website is not only aesthetically pleasing but also provides user-friendly navigation, ensuring seamless browsing.
work4.content2: The goal was to create a modern, dynamically functioning website that meets user needs and modern online presence requirements.
